admin.repRules.islandDescription: Stepping onto an island tile requires a Vehicle (raft, kayak, boat, hot air balloon…) in the bag.
admin.repRules.islandVehicleRequired: Require a Vehicle in the bag to access islands
admin.repRules.movementDescription: A short tap (keyboard, virtual D-pad or mouse) moves Synk exactly 1 cell. Holding a direction starts walking at the pace below, then switches to running after the configured hold threshold.
admin.repRules.poiObstacleCollisionEnabl: Block keyboard/D-pad movement into an obstacle POI (huts, villages, tavern, stable) — click-to-approach stays unchanged

admin.repRules.platform3dClimbDescriptio: Climbing (hold Space) onto a tile higher than Synk can, depending on the height difference crossed in one go (converted to "cubes"), inflict minor damage or even a fatal fall. Descending is always free and damage-free.

admin.repRules.defaultLakesEnabled: Show the 10 default lakes/ponds on the world map
admin.repRules.synkLimbAnimationDescript: Animates Synk's legs/arms/torso/head (subtle walk sway) across the 8 directions (cardinal + diagonal) in the isometric Platform. Disabling reverts to the original static rendering.
admin.repRules.synkAppearanceDescription: Synk's appearance settings in the 3D Platform. Eye blinking (two small white eyeball dots) makes the character feel more alive, with zero impact on stats or gameplay.
admin.repRules.depthAltitudePopupDescrip: Small non-blocking, blinking indicator shown while Synk stands on a water tile (depth) or a mountain/rock tile (altitude), in the isometric Platform and the World Map. Purely informational.
admin.repRules.kingdomDescription: The 400 Kingdom Quests form the main storyline (freeing PocaPoka and El Pipo from Zorghon). They unlock one by one, in order, once the condition below is met; 40 of them only appear on a full moon night (see the "Full moon" panel above).

admin.repRules.zorghonDescription: Once enough Kingdom Quests are solved, Zorghon the Vile and his captives PocaPoka & El Pipo appear on the map (islands included). Getting too close to Zorghon gives him a chance to relocate his captives elsewhere; reaching their position frees them and grants XP.

quest.npc_riddle_01: 🌀 NPC Riddle 1: I am a ring of stone covered in symbols, able to link two worlds in an instant. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_02: 🕳️ NPC Riddle 2: I bend space-time to link two distant points in the universe without crossing the distance between them. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_03: 🌲 NPC Riddle 3: I live in a cozy hole, love six meals a day, and hate adventures... until offered one. Who am I?
quest.npc_riddle_04: 🧌 NPC Riddle 4: I live under bridges, regenerate my wounds except against fire, and jealously guard my passage. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_05: 🧙 NPC Riddle 5: Without a wand or staff I am nothing, but with a spellbook I shape the elements. Who am I?
quest.npc_riddle_06: ⚒️ NPC Riddle 6: Small like a sprite, a blacksmith at heart, I tinker with mechanisms underground. Who am I?
quest.npc_riddle_07: 🐲 NPC Riddle 7: I breathe devastating flames and sit atop a burning hoard in my volcanic lair. What is my colour?
quest.npc_riddle_08: 🐉 NPC Riddle 8: I am the noblest and wisest of the metallic dragons, guardian of justice. What precious metal bears my name?
quest.npc_riddle_09: ⚔️ NPC Riddle 9: I was pulled from a stone or handed over by a Lady of the Lake; only a rightful king can wield me. What is my name?
quest.npc_riddle_10: 🛡️ NPC Riddle 10: I bear the cross on my breastplate, protect pilgrims, and guard ancient secrets beneath my temple. Who am I?
quest.npc_riddle_11: 🏰 NPC Riddle 11: Built by Daedalus to imprison a half-man half-bull monster, I have only one entrance but a thousand paths. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_12: 🐮 NPC Riddle 12: Half man, half bull, I haunt the heart of a Cretan labyrinth. Who am I?
quest.npc_riddle_13: 🌸 NPC Riddle 13: I melt the snow, bloom the flowers, and revive nature after winter. Which season am I?
quest.npc_riddle_14: ☀️ NPC Riddle 14: I bring the longest days and the highest sun of the year. Which season am I?
quest.npc_riddle_15: 🍂 NPC Riddle 15: I paint the leaves orange and red before they fall. Which season am I?
quest.npc_riddle_16: ❄️ NPC Riddle 16: I cover the world in white and freeze rivers under ice. Which season am I?
quest.npc_riddle_17: 🔮 NPC Riddle 17: Without me, no wizard could heal wounds instantly with a single sip. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_18: 📜 NPC Riddle 18: An engraved symbol carrying magical power, I seal secret passages and ancient spells. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_19: 🌍 NPC Riddle 19: I link Azeroth to Draenor, opened by the Orcs of the Horde to invade a new world. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_20: 🔺 NPC Riddle 20: Made of three golden triangles, I represent Power, Wisdom, and Courage united. What am I?

onboarding.step1.title: Welcome to the Lands of ZeldCraft
onboarding.step1.intro: Discover the world of Horizon ZeldCraft before setting off on an adventure with Synk!
onboarding.topic.world.title: The world of ZeldCraft
onboarding.topic.world.body: Synk is your faithful companion. Together, you explore the lands, seas and mountains of ZeldCraft, a realm rich in secrets, dangers… and friendships.
onboarding.topic.zorghon.title: Zorghon the Malevolent
onboarding.topic.zorghon.body: The sorcerer Zorghon has kidnapped Princess PocaPoka and her loyal sand sprite El Pipo. Your ultimate quest: track him down, defeat him and free them.
onboarding.topic.fragments.title: The 5 Fragments of the Runic Seal
onboarding.topic.fragments.body: Scattered across the world (quest relics, never lost even when fainting), these fragments must all be reunited to unlock the final quest of Chapter 40.
onboarding.topic.chapters.title: 40 chapters, 400 Kingdom Quests
onboarding.topic.chapters.body: The main storyline is made of 40 chapters of 10 riddles each. They unlock progressively as you advance, all the way to Zorghon.
onboarding.topic.npcs.title: Encounters & NPCs
onboarding.topic.npcs.body: Knights, wizards, hobbits, island natives… Many NPCs will offer you intermediate quests, hints and treasures along the way.
onboarding.topic.worldsToExplore.title: Worlds to discover
onboarding.topic.worldsToExplore.body: The World Map spans lands, mountains, seas, oceans, islands and archipelagos. Explore it to expand your territory and make new encounters.
onboarding.step2.title: Quests, dangers & kingdom life
onboarding.step2.intro: Understand how to progress through the adventure… and the risks that await you.
onboarding.topic.questTypes.title: Classic, NPC & Kingdom quests
onboarding.topic.questTypes.body: Classic and NPC quests (intermediate quests) can be solved freely. As they add up, they unlock the 400 Kingdom Quests one by one, leading to Zorghon.
onboarding.topic.fullMoon.title: Full moon quests
onboarding.topic.fullMoon.body: Some Kingdom Quests only appear on a full moon day (real calendar, shown in-game). Come back that day so you don't miss them!
onboarding.topic.islandQuests.title: Archipelago & wild island quests
onboarding.topic.islandQuests.body: Hop on a raft, canoe or ship (earned or purchased) to reach the islands and their brand-new intermediate quests.
onboarding.topic.fainting.title: Watch out for fainting!
onboarding.topic.fainting.body: Oxygen or Fatigue running out = Synk faints: he loses hit points, experience and a random item from his bag (quest relics are always protected).
onboarding.topic.chat.title: Chat with other players
onboarding.topic.chat.body: The Team Chat widget lets you exchange in real time with the other Tamers of the realm.
onboarding.topic.seasons.title: Rotating seasons & climate
onboarding.topic.seasons.body: Spring, summer, autumn and winter follow one another, influencing weather, mood and Synk's stats (force, fatigue…).
onboarding.topic.dlc.title: New adventures to come
onboarding.topic.dlc.body: Once Zorghon is defeated, new stories, quests, worlds and items (expansions/DLC) will extend the adventure.
onboarding.step3.title: The Tamer's toolkit
onboarding.step3.intro: A quick tour of the features and widgets to help you day to day.
onboarding.topic.feeding.title: Feeding Synk
onboarding.topic.feeding.body: Feed Synk every day, week, month and year to make him grow and keep his hunger and happiness at their best.
onboarding.topic.huts.title: Huts & rest
onboarding.topic.huts.body: Rest Synk in a hut to recover life and fatigue. If life gets too low, forced rest triggers automatically.
onboarding.topic.stats.title: Synk's statistics
onboarding.topic.stats.body: Life, Hunger, Happiness, Force, Spells, Oxygen, Fatigue and Experience: each gauge evolves with your actions and shapes Synk's survival and progression.
onboarding.topic.dice.title: Dice rolls & combat
onboarding.topic.dice.body: The Dice Roll widget handles the daily fate roll and combat. Your Force, your gear and random bonuses/penalties influence the outcome. During an NPC fight, the game flips a coin (configurable in Administration) between the classic 2d20 roll and the D&D Action Die (tetrahedron): Flight, Fight, Freeze or Fawn, each with its own life/XP/force gains or losses, or item rewards.
onboarding.topic.combat.title: Gear wear & bare-handed combat
onboarding.topic.combat.body: Every hit wears down your equipped weapon/armor a little. Without gear, Synk fights bare-handed with a penalty to the dice roll.
onboarding.topic.potions.title: Potions & Spells
onboarding.topic.potions.body: Brew or buy potions and spells to boost your stats, heal yourself, or gain temporary magical effects.
onboarding.topic.elixirs.title: Potion Combinations (Elixirs)
onboarding.topic.elixirs.body: In the Bag / Pouch (Potions tab), combine several potions/spells you own to craft a powerful Elixir: Life Invulnerability (24h), Titanic Force (×2, 30 min), Eternal Breath (full oxygen, 30 min), Endless Vigor (full stamina, 10 min), Royal Feast (full hunger), or even the Divine Sword of Light, a unique weapon unavailable in the shop. A blinking hourglass ⏳ at the top of the screen shows the countdown for each active Elixir.
onboarding.topic.mapmonde.title: World Map & 2D Platform
onboarding.topic.mapmonde.body: The World Map (mouse-wheel zoom, right-click drag, filters by type) and the isometric 2D Platform are synced in real time to explore the realm.
onboarding.topic.waterMountain.title: Water, mountains & oxygen
onboarding.topic.waterMountain.body: At sea or at altitude, Synk's oxygen gradually decreases (the air thins in the mountains); reach a land tile in time to recover!
onboarding.topic.platform3d.title: Minecraft-style 3D Platform
onboarding.topic.platform3d.body: Synk and his whole world (NPCs, familiars, huts, trees, mountains, lakes) come to life in 3D voxels, synced with the 2D Platform and World Map. Same directional keys (keyboard, mouse, virtual pad): hold for 1.5s to start running. Trees, rocks and NPCs block the way (left-click to interact, just like in 2D). Space + ↑ facing a mountain block to jump onto it and climb — beware, falling more than 4 cubes hurts Synk, and more than 10 cubes can be fatal (auto-revive). On a water tile, Synk sinks to chest height; right-click to dive fully and explore an underwater world full of fish and sea creatures. The camera automatically snaps back behind Synk while he walks. The window can be resized up to fullscreen, and equipped weapon/shield/helmet and other gear are visible directly on the model.
onboarding.topic.bagEquip.title: Bag & Equipment
onboarding.topic.bagEquip.body: Store weapons, armor, food, potions, vehicles, treasures, saddles and familiars in your bag, then drag them onto Synk to equip them.
onboarding.topic.familiars.title: Familiars
onboarding.topic.familiars.body: Recruit familiars who accompany and assist you on your travels and in combat.
onboarding.topic.shop.title: ZeldCraft Lands Shop
onboarding.topic.shop.body: Buy or sell all kinds of items (weapons, potions, vehicles, treasures…) sorted by category in the Shop.
onboarding.topic.widgetsChatKingdom.body: Two dedicated floating windows: chat with other players, and track your progress across the 400 Kingdom Quests.
onboarding.topic.instagram.title: Horizon ZeldCraft Community
onboarding.topic.instagram.body: Join the community on Instagram to follow the latest news, seasons and events of the realm.
onboarding.topic.eth.title: Top up with ETH
onboarding.topic.eth.body: Fund your wallet with ETH (Sepolia/Mainnet) to feed Synk and buy items — or pay directly by card, PayPal, Apple Pay or Google Pay (see the "Play without a wallet" topic below).

From the home page, try the game for free with "🎟️ Demo Access" (instant anonymous or Google sign-in — immediate access) or play right away with "💳 Play without a wallet" (Google/e-mail) and top up your coins by card, PayPal, Apple Pay or Google Pay.
onboarding.topic.accountSecurity.title: Account & password
onboarding.topic.accountSecurity.body: With an e-mail/password account ("Play without a wallet"), a welcome e-mail confirms your account creation and, from time to time, a progress report may be sent to you. You can change your password anytime via the "🔑 Reset password" button next to your address in-game (with confirmation and a security e-mail). quest.kingdom.ch38.riddle: ❓ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 38 (Salle du Trône Déchu): I fall every evening without ever breaking and I always come before dawn. What am I?
quest.kingdom.ch38.riddle.hint: I am darkest just before everything changes.
quest.kingdom.ch38.guardian: 🛡️ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 38 (Salle du Trône Déchu): None pass without facing this guardian, whose name alone is enough to make the local NPCs tremble. Who is he?
quest.kingdom.ch38.trial: ⚖️ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 38 (Salle du Trône Déchu): The Elders of the Kingdom demand a single quality to continue further in this quest. Which one? (hint: 9 letters)
quest.kingdom.ch38.moon: 🌕 Kingdom Quest — Chapter 38 (Salle du Trône Déchu): Under the full moon, Salle du Trône Déchu reveals a secret invisible the rest of the month. What name is given to it?
quest.kingdom.ch38.moon.hint: The name is simply "Full Moon of Salle du Trône Déchu".
quest.kingdom.ch39.glyph: 📜 Kingdom Quest — Chapter 39 (Cœur de la Citadelle): On a stone arch at Cœur de la Citadelle, an ancient glyph demands only one thing before it lights up: the name of the place itself. Which one?
quest.kingdom.ch39.location: 🗺️ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 39 (Cœur de la Citadelle): Between legend and danger, this territory shelters Cœur des Ténèbres and Cœur des Ténèbres, Garde Rapprochée de Zorghon at its heart. What is it called?
quest.kingdom.ch39.creature: 🐾 Kingdom Quest — Chapter 39 (Cœur de la Citadelle): Unwilling guardian of Cœur de la Citadelle, I only seek to protect my territory — to my own cost if faced without respect. Who am I?
quest.kingdom.ch39.ally: 🤝 Kingdom Quest — Chapter 39 (Cœur de la Citadelle): A traveling companion awaits you at Cœur de la Citadelle, ready to swell the ranks of the resistance against the Evil One. Who is he or she?
quest.kingdom.ch39.item: 💎 Kingdom Quest — Chapter 39 (Cœur de la Citadelle): A treasure of the Kingdom sleeps at Cœur de la Citadelle, waiting for a hero worthy of carrying it. What is this object?
quest.kingdom.ch39.spell: ✨ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 39 (Cœur de la Citadelle): An ancient spell still protects Cœur de la Citadelle, passed down from mage to mage for generations. What is it called?
quest.kingdom.ch39.riddle: ❓ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 39 (Cœur de la Citadelle): I am the first thing Zorghon stole from the Kingdom, even before the Princess. What am I?
quest.kingdom.ch39.riddle.hint: I'm truly appreciated only once lost.
quest.kingdom.ch39.guardian: 🛡️ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 39 (Cœur de la Citadelle): This protector (or jailer) jealously watches over this territory of the Kingdom. Who is he?
quest.kingdom.ch39.trial: ⚖️ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 39 (Cœur de la Citadelle): An invisible test judges every adventurer on an essential virtue before letting them pass. Which one? (hint: 7 letters)
quest.kingdom.ch39.moon: 🌕 Kingdom Quest — Chapter 39 (Cœur de la Citadelle): Legend says that once a month, Cœur de la Citadelle reveals a lunar mystery to those who know how to look. What is it called?
quest.kingdom.ch39.moon.hint: The name is simply "Full Moon of Cœur de la Citadelle".
quest.kingdom.ch40.glyph: 📜 Kingdom Quest — Chapter 40 (La Chute de Zorghon): Local NPCs say an ancient glyph guards La Chute de Zorghon and only fades once its true name is spoken. What is that name?
quest.kingdom.ch40.location: 🗺️ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 40 (La Chute de Zorghon): Neither quite a village nor a ruin, this feared place shelters Garde Rapprochée de Zorghon and lies under the guard of Zorghon le Maléfique. What is its name?
quest.kingdom.ch40.creature: 🐾 Kingdom Quest — Chapter 40 (La Chute de Zorghon): The NPCs of La Chute de Zorghon avoid saying my name after dusk. Who am I?
quest.kingdom.ch40.ally: 🤝 Kingdom Quest — Chapter 40 (La Chute de Zorghon): The entire Kingdom holds its breath, ready to welcome back its princess and her faithful sand-sprite companion. Who are they, she and him?
quest.kingdom.ch40.ally.hint: She wears a crown of golden sand; he never leaves her side.
quest.kingdom.ch40.item: 💎 Kingdom Quest — Chapter 40 (La Chute de Zorghon): A legendary relic of La Chute de Zorghon awaits only to be claimed by whoever can name it. What is its name?
quest.kingdom.ch40.spell: ✨ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 40 (La Chute de Zorghon): It's said a unique spell was invented at La Chute de Zorghon to push back the darkness. What is this spell?
quest.kingdom.ch40.riddle: ❓ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 40 (La Chute de Zorghon): I am what remains when all seems lost, PocaPoka's last weapon against Zorghon's darkness. What am I?
quest.kingdom.ch40.riddle.hint: I cannot be stolen as long as the heart still beats.
quest.kingdom.ch40.guardian: 🛡️ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 40 (La Chute de Zorghon): He kidnapped Princess PocaPoka and her faithful El Pipo to rule over the Kingdom's ashes from the depths of his citadel. Who is this Evil One?
quest.kingdom.ch40.guardian.hint: His name alone is enough to chill the blood of the Kingdom's NPCs.
quest.kingdom.ch40.trial: ⚖️ Kingdom Quest — Chapter 40 (La Chute de Zorghon): This chapter of the Kingdom opens only to those who prove a specific virtue through their deeds. Which one? (hint: 5 letters)
quest.kingdom.ch40.moon: 🌕 Kingdom Quest — Chapter 40 (La Chute de Zorghon): On this full-moon night, Zorghon's seals finally weaken. It's time to deliver the final blow to free Princess PocaPoka and her faithful El Pipo. What light always follows the darkest night and seals the Evil One's defeat?
quest.kingdom.ch40.moon.hint: It rises every morning, even after the worst of nights.
quest.island_01: 🏝️ Island Riddle 1: The most modest of the archipelago's three sisters, so small you can walk around it in one morning. What is its name?
quest.island_01.hint: It gives its name to the first NPC most travelers of the archipelago meet.
quest.island_02: 🏝️ Island Riddle 2: The middle sister of the archipelago, neither the smallest nor the largest, famed for its totem carvers. What is its name?
quest.island_02.hint: Its shaman shares the same name.
quest.island_03: 🏝️ Island Riddle 3: The largest of the archipelago's three sisters, its lagoon is said to hide a treasure sunk three generations ago. What is its name?
quest.island_03.hint: A fisherman of the same name watches over its lagoon.
quest.island_04: 🏝️ Island Riddle 4: An isolated island south of the territory, said to hold an unknown creature's egg waiting to hatch. What is its name?
quest.island_04.hint: Its colour evokes an emerald resting on the ocean.
quest.island_05: 🏝️ Island Riddle 5: A large island to the East, the first to see Zorghon flee out to sea. What is its name?
quest.island_05.hint: The sun rises there before the rest of the territory.
quest.island_06: 🏝️ Island Riddle 6: A calm stretch of water at the heart of the archipelago where priestess Marama listens to the songs of the tides. What am I?
quest.island_06.hint: People fish there at low tide without ever venturing too far from shore.
quest.island_07: 🏝️ Island Riddle 7: A submerged natural barrier where creatures unrecorded in the Kingdom's books roam. What am I?
quest.island_07.hint: Canoes carefully go around it to avoid running aground.
quest.island_08: 🏝️ Island Riddle 8: Tangled roots at the boundary of land and sea, guardian Toa's refuge from storms. What am I?
quest.island_08.hint: Neither quite land nor quite sea.
quest.island_09: 🏝️ Island Riddle 9: A stretch of fine sand where storyteller Fetia tells the legend of the princess lost beyond the seas. What am I?
quest.island_09.hint: Its name evokes both sand and storm.
quest.island_10: 🏝️ Island Riddle 10: A small bay battered by sea spray, connected to the mainland by a thin strip of land. What am I?
quest.island_10.hint: Smaller than a bay, more sheltered than an open beach.
quest.island_11: 🐙 Island Riddle 11: A giant of the deep with endless tentacles, terror of fishermen who venture too far from the lagoon. Who am I?
quest.island_11.hint: I'm never seen whole, only my arms emerging from the waves.
quest.island_12: 🐍 Island Riddle 12: I slip between coral branches, as colourful as I am venomous. Who am I?
quest.island_12.hint: My bright colours warn predators to keep their distance.
quest.island_13: 🐒 Island Riddle 13: I leap between bamboo stalks, invisible except to those who truly know how to look. Who am I?
quest.island_13.hint: The natives say I bring luck to whoever spots me.
quest.island_14: 🦜 Island Riddle 14: I repeat travelers' words, but only the initiated understand my prophecies. Who am I?
quest.island_14.hint: I'm consulted before every great sea voyage.
quest.island_15: 🦀 Island Riddle 15: My shell is harder than steel, and I defend my sandy territory with giant pincers. Who am I?
quest.island_15.hint: I walk sideways but rarely back down from an intruder.
quest.island_16: 🎐 Island Riddle 16: Translucent and glowing at night, my touch can paralyze a grown man. Who am I?
quest.island_16.hint: I float effortlessly, carried by the current.
quest.island_17: 🦈 Island Riddle 17: Striped like a land beast, I patrol the reefs in search of my next prey. Who am I?
quest.island_17.hint: My stripes resemble those of a great cat.
quest.island_18: 🐢 Island Riddle 18: I saw the archipelago born and I return every year to lay my eggs on the same beach. Who am I?
quest.island_18.hint: My shell bears the scars of a thousand storms.
quest.island_19: 🦇 Island Riddle 19: I fly by night between the palm trees, feeding on fruit rather than blood. Who am I?
quest.island_19.hint: Despite my name, I do the villagers no harm.
quest.island_20: ⚡ Island Riddle 20: I coil in the shallows and unleash a lightning-fast shock on whoever disturbs me. Who am I?
quest.island_21: 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Island Riddle 21: Spiritual guide of the middle island, he speaks with the spirits of the sea before every great decision. Who is he?
quest.island_21.hint: He shares the name of his island.
quest.island_22: 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Island Riddle 22: Respected elder of the smallest island of the archipelago, keeper of its secrets despite its modest size. Who is she?
quest.island_22.hint: Her island can be visited in one morning; her knowledge cannot.
quest.island_23: 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Island Riddle 23: Fisherman of the archipelago's largest island, convinced a treasure sleeps at the bottom of its lagoon. Who is he?
quest.island_23.hint: He never leaves his canoe without his lucky net.
quest.island_24: 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Island Riddle 24: Scout of the great eastern island, the first to see Zorghon flee out to sea. Who is he?
quest.island_24.hint: His island bears the name of the sunrise.
quest.island_25: 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Island Riddle 25: Totem carver of the middle island, every totem he carves protects a secret of the bamboo forest. Who is he?
quest.island_25.hint: His works guard the forest more surely than sentinels.
quest.island_26: 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Island Riddle 26: Guardian of the southern island, she watches over a creature's egg no one has ever seen hatch. Who is she?
quest.island_26.hint: They say she sings a lullaby to the egg every night.
quest.island_27: 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Island Riddle 27: Sailmaker of the archipelago, her creations have carried many adventurers out to sea. Who is she?
quest.island_27.hint: No storm ever tears her sails.
quest.island_28: 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Island Riddle 28: A sage living in the shade of a giant tree on the southern island, older than the whole Kingdom combined. Who is he?
quest.island_28.hint: His tree bears the same name as he does.
quest.island_29: 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Island Riddle 29: Blacksmith of the archipelago, he forges blades from coral hardened by volcanic fire. Who is he?
quest.island_29.hint: His workshop always smells of salt and embers.
quest.island_30: 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Island Riddle 30: Navigator of the archipelago, she reads the sky to guide rafts between the islands without ever getting lost. Who is she?
quest.island_30.hint: She never consults a map, only the stars.
quest.island_31: 💎 Island Riddle 31: A string of pearls as dark as night, once worn by a forgotten queen of the islands. What am I?
quest.island_31.hint: They say it brings luck to whoever finds it honestly.
quest.island_32: 🧭 Island Riddle 32: Made of polished coral, I always point to the nearest land, never north. What am I?
quest.island_33: 🛶 Island Riddle 33: Carved from a single trunk, I let you cross the archipelago's calm waters without ever capsizing. What am I?
quest.island_33.hint: My side float keeps me from tipping over.
quest.island_34: 🎭 Island Riddle 34: Carved from driftwood, I depict the face of a protective ancestor. What am I?
quest.island_35: 🔱 Island Riddle 35: Forged for the first scout of the Island of Dawn, I shine like the rising sun. What am I?
quest.island_35.hint: Its gleam announces the morning even before the sun.
quest.island_36: 🐚 Island Riddle 36: Held to the ear, I make the ocean's song heard even far from shore. What am I?
quest.island_36.hint: I'm given as a farewell gift before a long journey.
quest.island_37: 🦈 Island Riddle 37: Carved from a tiger shark's tooth, I protect my wearer from creatures of the deep. What am I?
quest.island_37.hint: I'm worn around the neck before diving.
quest.island_38: 🕸️ Island Riddle 38: Woven from precious threads, I catch even the wiliest fish without ever tearing. What am I?
quest.island_38.hint: No fish bites hard enough to break me.
quest.island_39: 🥁 Island Riddle 39: Struck during great ceremonies, my rhythm tells the story of the islands' first inhabitants. What am I?
quest.island_39.hint: My echo can be heard as far as the bamboo forest.
quest.island_40: 🪞 Island Riddle 40: Polished by the sea foam, I reflect not the face but the true desire of whoever looks at me. What am I?
quest.island_41: 🌬️ Island Riddle 41: This spell calms the raging sea for the length of a canoe crossing. What is its name?
quest.island_41.hint: Navigators whisper it before weighing anchor.
quest.island_42: 🗿 Island Riddle 42: This totem, carved facing the reef, repels the most aggressive creatures of the deep. What is its name?
quest.island_42.hint: It's planted at the entrance of every coastal village.
quest.island_43: 🎶 Island Riddle 43: This ritual chant predicts the exact hour of the rising tide. What is its name?
quest.island_43.hint: Only the priestess of the lagoon knows it in full.
quest.island_44: 🌴 Island Riddle 44: This blessing makes palm trees bear twice as many coconuts in one season. What is its name?
quest.island_44.hint: It's recited at sunrise, never at dusk.
quest.island_45: 🌀 Island Riddle 45: This dreaded spell unleashes winds capable of capsizing an entire fleet. What is its name?
quest.island_45.hint: Only the most experienced shamans dare speak it.
quest.island_46: ✨ Island Riddle 46: This magic shimmer makes any object shine as if it were new. What is its name?
quest.island_46.hint: It's used to restore treasures damaged by salt.
quest.island_47: 🌿 Island Riddle 47: This ancient whisper lets one understand the silent language of mangrove roots. What is its name?
quest.island_47.hint: Only the guardian of the mangroves fully masters it.
quest.island_48: 🔥 Island Riddle 48: This ritual dance calls upon the protection of the dormant volcano at the heart of the wild island. What is its name?
quest.island_48.hint: It's danced only once a generation.
quest.island_49: 🌫️ Island Riddle 49: This enchanted veil hides an entire raft within an impenetrable tropical mist. What is its name?
quest.island_49.hint: It lasts only long enough to escape immediate danger.
quest.island_50: 🦈 Island Riddle 50: This ritual call summons the greatest of the tiger sharks so it protects the archipelago rather than attacking it. What is its name?
quest.island_50.hint: It's spoken only as a last resort, in times of great peril.
quest.guardians_camel: 🐫 Three-Headed Camel Guardians: Three heads I bear, three gazes I cast upon whoever dares approach my treasure. Only one who becomes invisible to my six eyes may pass without a fight. What must you become to deceive me?
quest.guardians_camel.hint: Neither shield nor sword will help you here — you must vanish from their sight.
treasure.dague_rouille: 🗡️ Rusty Dagger of the Secret Passage
npc.island.eclaireur_aurore: Scout Rangi of the Island of Dawn
